description:
We are a team of passionate STEM students from Uzbekistan.

Our team brings experience in mechanical engineering, Python programming, machine learning, robotics, and web development. We aim to develop an innovative, practical, and scientifically grounded solution using NASA's open data.

We value teamwork, curiosity, and the willingness to experiment with new ideas. We are interested in collaborating with people skilled in software development, data analysis, UI/UX design, and space science.
